title: Iris assistant: streaming UI, single-source prompt, accessibility, server cleanup
body:
## Description

Implements the Iris upgrade plan across the PWA (`iris.html`), the local FastAPI server (`iris-local.py`), the `iris/` package, and the supporting test suite. The hosted `/api/*` contracts are unchanged and no new runtime dependencies are added.

- **Single source of truth for the system prompt.** The divergent inline `SYSTEM_PROMPT` literal in `iris.html` is replaced by an embedded `<script id="iris-system-prompt" type="text/plain">` block populated from `iris/system-prompt.md`. `iris-local.py` re-injects the canonical text into `iris.html`/`index.html` at serve time (cached, lock-guarded). A missing tag warns visibly rather than falling back to a second prompt.
- **Streaming + Stop.** `requestIrisReply` now consumes SSE from the proxy / Anthropic / OpenAI / OpenAI-compatible endpoints via a generic `readSSE` + `parseSSEEvent` pair; tokens stream into the bubble. An `AbortController`-driven Stop button replaces Send while a reply is in flight; partial replies are preserved with `_[stopped]_`, abort-before-first-token surfaces a system notice, and non-`ReadableStream` environments fall back to JSON.
- **Conversation toolbar.** New / Export `.md` / Export `.json` / Copy-last-reply, all client-side.
- **Accessibility.** Composer is a real `<form>` with a `.sr-only` label, skip-to-composer link, `aria-expanded`/`aria-controls` on the advanced toggle, `:focus-visible` rings, `prefers-reduced-motion`, and a full `prefers-color-scheme: dark` palette.
- **Advanced ("BYO AI") hardening.** Show/hide key toggle, "stays in this browser" notice, `validateAdvancedSettings` (URL parse + `http(s):` only + provider-appropriate required fields), and HTTP-status-aware (401/403/429/5xx) errors rendered as a system notice with a Try-again button instead of as Iris's words.
- **`iris-local.py` cleanup.** Bare `except Exception` on `/api/chat` is replaced by a logged-and-sanitised error path (`log.exception` + generic 500 body, no leak of exception class or message). CORS tightens to `http://localhost:<port>` + `http://127.0.0.1:<port>` by default with a `--cors-allow-all` opt-in. New `--host` (default `127.0.0.1`) and `--config` flags. Explicit `iris.html`/`index.html` routes precede the static mount.
- **Version surfacing.** `iris.__version__ = "1.3.0"` becomes the single source; surfaced in the startup banner, via a new `GET /api/version`, and in the PWA footer.
- **Tests.** New `tests/test_iris_prompt_consistency.py`; new `tests/iris_sse.test.mjs` (node:test units that extract the parser straight from `iris.html`); extensions to `tests/test_iris_local.py` (`/api/version`, default vs `--cors-allow-all` CORS preflight, `--host` / `--config`, prompt-injection helper, sanitised 5xx) and `tests/test_iris_static_assets.py` (embedded prompt, ARIA, toolbar, advanced hardening).
- **Docs.** `iris/README.md` documents the new flags, `/api/version`, the prompt-injection guarantee, and the streaming / Stop / export behaviour.

## Relevance to the Burgess Principle

Convergence on the canonical prompt eliminates a real divergence between Cloud Mode and Sovereign Local Mode users — both now receive the same Iris voice, the same binary-test framing, and the same SOVEREIGN/NULL/AMBIGUOUS classification rules from `iris/system-prompt.md`. The streaming UI plus conversation export keeps "preserve verifiable records" practical on slow links. Tightening loopback CORS, sanitising backend errors, and surfacing API-key handling honestly reinforce the local-first, privacy-first posture the Principle requires.
